//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-2202
//  Weekly Open + Volatility + Vol Report
//  Weekly open line, Volatility state meter, Volatility report generator
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-2202 · Weekly Open + Volatility + Vol Report", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st2_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show weekly open",  group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_col = input.color(#c9a84c, "Weekly open colour", group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_wid = input.int(1, "Weekly open width", minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = "Starter · Weekly open")

st2_o = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", open, lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st2_on ? st2_o : na, "Weekly open", color = st2_col, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = st2_wid)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn2_on    = input.bool(true, "Show volatility state",        group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_len   = input.int(14,    "ATR length",   minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_look  = input.int(500,   "Lookback",     minval = 50,    group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_lo    = input.int(30,    "Low below %",  minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_hi    = input.int(70,    "High above %", minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_sz    = input.string("Tiny", "Volatility text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_pos   = input.string("Top right", "Volatility table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Main · Volatility state")

mn2_atr   = ta.atr(mn2_len)
mn2_rank  = ta.percentrank(mn2_atr, mn2_look)
mn2_word  = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? "LOW" : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? "HIGH" : "NORMAL"
mn2_col   = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? #9aa0a6 : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? #c9a84c : #00abff

mn2_size  = mn2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : mn2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : mn2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

mn2_where = mn2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : mn2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : mn2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table mn2_tbl = table.new(mn2_where, 2, 2, border_width = 0)
if mn2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 0, mn2_word,     text_color = mn2_col, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 1, "PERCENTILE", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 1, str.tostring(mn2_rank, "#") + "%", text_color = #f2f0ea, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
// (none selected)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds2_on  = input.bool(true, "Show volatility report", group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_len = input.int(14, "Report ATR length", minval = 1,    group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Report text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_pos = input.string("Bottom right", "Volatility report position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")

ds2_atr   = ta.atr(ds2_len)
ds2_atr20 = ta.sma(ds2_atr, 20)
ds2_datr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_watr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_rel   = ds2_atr20 > 0 ? 100.0 * ds2_atr / ds2_atr20 : 0.0
ds2_col   = ds2_rel > 120 ? #c9a84c : ds2_rel < 80 ? #9aa0a6 : #00abff

ds2_size = ds2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

ds2_where = ds2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds2_t = table.new(ds2_where, 2, 5, border_width = 0)
ds2_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds2_row(1, "ATR (chart)", str.tostring(ds2_atr,  format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(2, "ATR daily",   str.tostring(ds2_datr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(3, "ATR weekly",  str.tostring(ds2_watr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(4, "vs 20 avg",   str.tostring(ds2_rel, "#") + "%", ds2_col)
